admission.justification: Counting an abandoned row in the chain forces an operator to relabel or discard a leaf that will never run, which rewrites the developer's record; letting the abandoned label hide a landed leaf would silently drop a landed leaf from the chain proof.

applicability: Atomic master closeout and its exact leaf document/enclosure population, including abandoned rows and any retained enclosures.
conditions: Every present enclosure is inspected for recorded completed integration.
exclusions: Organizational task-tool completion, governed by its separate transition predicate.
Rows in another unresolved status remain ordinary completion blockers.
statement: An abandoned row of an atomic master is outside the master's landing chain: closeout needs no enclosure or landing for it and ignores an enclosure of it whose integration is not completed, while an abandoned row whose enclosure records a completed integration refuses by name.
